narration: 秦攻韩上党，上党守冯亭以地降赵。秦赵两军相持于长平。
赵将廉颇坚壁不出。秦人于是在邯郸散布流言：秦所畏者，独赵括为将耳。
赵王以赵括代廉颇。赵括之母上书，说括不可使将，王不听。
秦暗中以白起为上将军。赵括一到，便出兵击秦。
秦军佯败，奇兵绝其后——
赵括亲自搏战，被秦军射杀，赵军大败。《史记·白起列传》载降卒四十万被坑杀，数字历来存疑。

prompt.zh:
【水墨视频生成提示词】战国 · 纸上谈兵（长平之战）

画幅与时长：16:9 横屏（1920×1080，竖屏可改 9:16 并保持主体居中），24fps，总长约 55 秒，共 7 个镜头；单镜时长超出生成器上限时可逐镜生成后剪辑。

风格：中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：咖啡色、酒红，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。

时代与场景：战国 · 秦昭王四十七年，赵孝成王六年（前 260 年）。列国都城、长城雏形、步骑大军、竹简。

人物：
- 白起（秦·武安君，秦将）：深衣，胡服短衣，漆皮甲，青铜长剑与弩；武将甲胄披挂，佩剑或执兵器；秘密代王龁为上将军，断赵粮道，围赵军四十六日
- 赵括（赵·赵将，赵奢之子）：深衣，胡服短衣，漆皮甲，青铜长剑与弩；武将甲胄披挂，佩剑或执兵器；代廉颇为将，出击被围，突围中被射杀
- 廉颇（赵·赵将）：深衣，胡服短衣，漆皮甲，青铜长剑与弩；武将甲胄披挂，佩剑或执兵器；坚壁不出
- 赵孝成王（赵·赵丹）：深衣，胡服短衣，漆皮甲，青铜长剑与弩；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；中秦反间，以赵括代廉颇
- 王龁（秦·秦将）：深衣，胡服短衣，漆皮甲，青铜长剑与弩；武将甲胄披挂，佩剑或执兵器；长平前期秦军主将
- 赵括之母（赵·赵奢之妻）：深衣，胡服短衣；女子衣着，依身份；上书言括不可使将
- 冯亭（韩·韩上党守）：深衣，胡服短衣，漆皮甲，青铜长剑与弩；依身份的平民、工匠、侍从或兵卒衣着；以上党降赵

分镜：
镜头 1（0–8 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山、皴法山石；中景：河水｜动作：上党山地，丹水之滨｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：旷野风声｜屏幕文字：片名「纸上谈兵」竖排书法与朱印「长平」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「秦攻韩上党，上党守冯亭以地降赵。秦赵两军相持于长平。」
镜头 2（8–17 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：主体：廉颇、盾墙、军阵、长兵如林｜动作：廉颇坚壁，三年相持｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；淡墨人影成排，远处虚化；枯笔竖线密如森林｜声音：环境：军营鼓声；音效：远处鼓声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「赵将廉颇坚壁不出。秦人于是在邯郸散布流言：秦所畏者，独赵括为将耳。」
镜头 3（17–25 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：赵孝成王、赵括｜动作：邯郸流言：秦独畏赵括｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；重墨立柱，空间纵深｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：低语｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「赵王以赵括代廉颇。赵括之母上书，说括不可使将，王不听。」
镜头 4（25–32 秒，7 秒）｜运镜：手持式轻微震动，节奏急促｜构图：主体：白起、骑兵、军阵、长兵如林｜动作：赵括出击，秦军佯败｜水墨效果：墨迹溅开切入；马蹄踏处墨点四溅；淡墨人影成排，远处虚化；墨点四散（如马蹄踏墨）｜声音：环境：远处厮杀声；音效：马蹄声、兵刃相击｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「秦暗中以白起为上将军。赵括一到，便出兵击秦。」
镜头 5（32–38 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：主体：弓箭；飞白题字「长平之箭」｜动作：粮道断绝，四十六日｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；泼墨飞溅，朱砂一点｜声音：环境：夜风；音效：箭雨｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「秦军佯败，奇兵绝其后——」
镜头 6（38–49 秒，11 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；山河远景｜动作：正史结局：赵括亲自搏战，被秦军射杀，赵军大败。《史记·白起列传》载降卒四十万被坑杀，数字历来存疑。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「赵括亲自搏战，被秦军射杀，赵军大败。《史记·白起列传》载降卒四十万被坑杀，数字历来存疑。」
镜头 7（49–55 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文；右下角朱印「长平」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处

声音：背景乐：铜鼓，庄重原始，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：旷野风声、军营鼓声、宫殿回响、远处厮杀声、夜风；音效：远处鼓声、低语、马蹄声、兵刃相击、箭雨；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

字幕与屏幕文字：片头：右上竖排书法片名「纸上谈兵」，副题「长平之战」，朱印「长平」；旁白字幕：简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体，白底留边；所有文字必须准确，不得出现错字、乱码或英文。

负面提示词：写实照片，3D 渲染，CG 质感，油画厚涂，赛博朋克，日式动漫脸，美颜网红脸，高饱和霓虹色，现代建筑，现代服饰，汽车电线，塑料质感，英文字母，乱码文字，错别字，水印，签名，logo，多余肢体，手指畸形，五官崩坏，人物变形闪烁，画面抖动撕裂，时代错置：清代辫发与马褂、幞头与圆领袍、铁甲与马镫
prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Warring States period (475–221 BCE) · Strategy on Paper: the Battle of Changping (「纸上谈兵」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 55 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained brown and wine red accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

Setting: Warring States period (475–221 BCE), 260 BCE — capital cities of rival states, early walls, massed infantry and cavalry, bamboo slips.

Characters:
- Bai Qi (白起) — general, Qin; shenyi robes, short "barbarian" riding tunics, lacquered leather armour, long bronze swords and crossbows; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand
- Zhao Kuo (赵括) — general, Zhao; shenyi robes, short "barbarian" riding tunics, lacquered leather armour, long bronze swords and crossbows; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand
- Lian Po (廉颇) — general, Zhao; shenyi robes, short "barbarian" riding tunics, lacquered leather armour, long bronze swords and crossbows; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand
- Zhao Xiaochengwang (赵孝成王) — ruler, Zhao; shenyi robes, short "barbarian" riding tunics, lacquered leather armour, long bronze swords and crossbows; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence
- Wang He (王龁) — general, Qin; shenyi robes, short "barbarian" riding tunics, lacquered leather armour, long bronze swords and crossbows; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand
- Zhao Kuozhimu (赵括之母) — commoner, Zhao; shenyi robes, short "barbarian" riding tunics; female dress appropriate to rank
- Feng Ting (冯亭) — commoner, Han; shenyi robes, short "barbarian" riding tunics, lacquered leather armour, long bronze swords and crossbows; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–8 s, 8 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains, textured rocks; midground: river | Action: The Shangdang highlands by the Dan River | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「纸上谈兵」 with vermilion seal 「长平」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「秦攻韩上党，上党守冯亭以地降赵。秦赵两军相持于长平。」
Shot 2 (8–17 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: subject: Lian Po, shield wall, army ranks, forest of spears | Action: Lian Po holds his walls through three years of stalemate | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; rows of pale ink figures fading into distance; dense dry-brush verticals like a forest of spears | Sound: ambience: camp drums; SFX: distant drums | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「赵将廉颇坚壁不出。秦人于是在邯郸散布流言：秦所畏者，独赵括为将耳。」
Shot 3 (17–25 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Zhao Xiaochengwang, Zhao Kuo | Action: Rumours in Handan: Qin fears only Zhao Kuo | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; heavy ink pillars giving depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: murmuring | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「赵王以赵括代廉颇。赵括之母上书，说括不可使将，王不听。」
Shot 4 (25–32 s, 7 s) | Camera: subtle handheld shake, urgent rhythm | Composition: subject: Bai Qi, cavalry, army ranks, forest of spears | Action: Zhao Kuo attacks; Qin feigns retreat | Ink FX: cut in on an ink splatter; ink spatters where hooves strike; rows of pale ink figures fading into distance; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: hoofbeats, clashing weapons | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「秦暗中以白起为上将军。赵括一到，便出兵击秦。」
Shot 5 (32–38 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: subject: bow; dry-brush calligraphy 「长平之箭」 | Action: Supply lines cut for forty-six days | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; ink splash with a single vermilion accent | Sound: ambience: night wind; SFX: rain of arrows | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「秦军佯败，奇兵绝其后——」
Shot 6 (38–49 s, 11 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: Zhao Kuo is shot dead in the fighting and Zhao is crushed; the burial of the surrendered troops is recorded, its scale disputed. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「赵括亲自搏战，被秦军射杀，赵军大败。《史记·白起列传》载降卒四十万被坑杀，数字历来存疑。」
Shot 7 (49–55 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation; vermilion seal 「长平」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source

Sound: Music: bronze drums, solemn and primal, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: wind over open plains, camp drums, palace hall reverb, distant battle, night wind; SFX: distant drums, murmuring, hoofbeats, clashing weapons, rain of arrows; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「纸上谈兵」, subtitle 「长平之战」, vermilion seal 「长平」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets, futou caps and round-collar robes, iron plate armour and stirrups

strings.scene.zhanguo.qiefu.title: 窃符救赵
strings.scene.zhanguo.qiefu.subtitle: 信陵君
strings.vo.01: 秦围邯郸。赵平原君之夫人，是魏公子信陵君之姊，数次遣使求救。
strings.vo.02: 魏王派将军晋鄙率十万人救赵，却因秦王威胁，令其留军于邺，名为救赵，实持两端。
strings.vo.03: 夷门监者侯嬴献计：兵符在王卧内，如姬最幸，能窃之。
strings.vo.04: 如姬感公子为其报父仇之恩，果然窃得虎符。
strings.vo.05: 晋鄙合符之后仍有疑心——
strings.scene.zhanguo.qiefu.fork.prompt: 窃符救赵——依《史记》直书，还是听演义《东周列国志》？
strings.scene.zhanguo.qiefu.canon.intro: 邯郸城中粮尽，平原君的书信一封接一封。魏军却停在邺下，不再前进。
strings.scene.zhanguo.qiefu.end.canon: 秦军解围而去。侯嬴在公子到达晋鄙军中那天，北乡自刭。
strings.scene.zhanguo.qiefu.legend.disclaimer: 以下按《东周列国志》的演义铺陈改编，主干同《史记》，细节与对话为小说增饰。
strings.scene.zhanguo.qiefu.legend.intro: 演义加写了信陵君初见侯嬴时执辔恭候、侯嬴故意久立市中与朱亥交谈的场面，以显公子下士。
strings.scene.zhanguo.qiefu.end.legend: 公子北行，侯嬴留在夷门。演义的结局与正史相同。

artPrompts.prompt:
中国水墨写意素材图（人物立绘），题材：窃符救赵·信陵君（前 257 年）。
画风：写意水墨，焦墨—浓墨—淡墨分层次，枯笔飞白与泼墨墨点飞溅，笔触边缘自然晕开；点缀色（用量克制，只作点睛）：黑色 #1a1a1a、咖啡色 #af8c59、酒红色 #803134。
背景：纯透明（alpha 通道；无纸纹、无底色、无投影、无环境光），每格可整格抠图。
版式：3×3 均匀网格，自上而下、自左而右排列；每格只放一件完整独立素材，居中等大、四周留白、互不重叠、风格统一。
清单：
第 1 行：1. 信陵君（魏无忌）（魏·宗室后妃）；2. 侯嬴（夷门监者）（魏·其他）；3. 朱亥（屠者）（魏·其他）。
第 2 行：4. 如姬（魏王宠姬）（魏·宗室后妃）；5. 晋鄙（魏将）（魏·武将）；6. 魏安釐王（魏圉）（魏·君主）。

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：咖啡色、酒红，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained brown and wine red accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

setting.zh: 战国 · 魏安釐王二十年（前 257 年）。列国都城、长城雏形、步骑大军、竹简。
setting.en: Warring States period (475–221 BCE), 257 BCE — capital cities of rival states, early walls, massed infantry and cavalry, bamboo slips.

characters.name: 信陵君

shots.vo: 秦围邯郸。赵平原君之夫人，是魏公子信陵君之姊，数次遣使求救。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–8 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：城墙雉堞、烟｜动作：邯郸被围，城头烽烟｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；焦墨勾出城垛轮廓；淡墨烟气横向飘散｜声音：环境：旷野风声｜屏幕文字：片名「窃符救赵」竖排书法与朱印「窃符救赵」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「秦围邯郸。赵平原君之夫人，是魏公子信陵君之姊，数次遣使求救。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–8 s, 8 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: crenellated city wall, smoke | Action: Handan under siege, beacon smoke on the walls | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; scorched-ink outline of battlements; pale ink smoke drifting sideways | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「窃符救赵」 with vermilion seal 「窃符救赵」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「秦围邯郸。赵平原君之夫人，是魏公子信陵君之姊，数次遣使求救。」

shots.vo: 魏王派将军晋鄙率十万人救赵，却因秦王威胁，令其留军于邺，名为救赵，实持两端。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（8–18 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：卷轴；主体：平原君｜动作：平原君书信不断，责魏不救｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：竹简翻动｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「魏王派将军晋鄙率十万人救赵，却因秦王威胁，令其留军于邺，名为救赵，实持两端。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (8–18 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: scroll; subject: Ping Yuanjun | Action: Lord Pingyuan's letters keep coming, blaming Wei for not helping | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「魏王派将军晋鄙率十万人救赵，却因秦王威胁，令其留军于邺，名为救赵，实持两端。」

shots.vo: 夷门监者侯嬴献计：兵符在王卧内，如姬最幸，能窃之。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（18–25 秒，7 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：城墙雉堞；主体：侯嬴、信陵君｜动作：夷门：侯嬴献计｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；焦墨勾出城垛轮廓｜声音：环境：夜风；音效：脚步声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「夷门监者侯嬴献计：兵符在王卧内，如姬最幸，能窃之。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (18–25 s, 7 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: crenellated city wall; subject: Hou Ying, Xin Lingjun | Action: At the Yi Gate, Hou Ying offers a plan | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; scorched-ink outline of battlements | Sound: ambience: night wind; SFX: footsteps | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「夷门监者侯嬴献计：兵符在王卧内，如姬最幸，能窃之。」

shots.vo: 如姬感公子为其报父仇之恩，果然窃得虎符。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（25–31 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：远景：月；中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：如姬｜动作：如姬入卧内，窃得兵符｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；重墨立柱，空间纵深；月轮留白，四周淡墨烘染｜声音：环境：夜风；音效：衣袂摩挲｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「如姬感公子为其报父仇之恩，果然窃得虎符。」
shots.en: Shot 4 (25–31 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: background: moon; midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Ru Ji | Action: Lady Ru steals the military tally from the king's chamber | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; heavy ink pillars giving depth; moon left blank with pale wash around it | Sound: ambience: night wind; SFX: rustling silk | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「如姬感公子为其报父仇之恩，果然窃得虎符。」

shots.vo: 晋鄙合符之后仍有疑心——
shots.zh: 镜头 5（31–37 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：主体：大刀；飞白题字「铁椎」｜动作：邺下：铁椎一击｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；四角暗角收拢；兵刃金属寒光一闪；画面定格成一幅水墨画；泼墨飞溅，朱砂一点｜声音：环境：战后余风；音效：锤击｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「晋鄙合符之后仍有疑心——」
shots.en: Shot 5 (31–37 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: subject: broadsword; dry-brush calligraphy 「铁椎」 | Action: At Ye an iron mace strikes | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; vignette closing in from the corners; a cold metallic glint on the blade; freeze into a still ink painting; ink splash with a single vermilion accent | Sound: ambience: lingering wind after battle; SFX: hammer strike | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「晋鄙合符之后仍有疑心——」

shots.vo: 秦军解围而去。侯嬴在公子到达晋鄙军中那天，北乡自刭。
shots.zh: 镜头 6（37–45 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；山河远景｜动作：正史结局：秦军解围而去。侯嬴在公子到达晋鄙军中那天，北乡自刭。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「秦军解围而去。侯嬴在公子到达晋鄙军中那天，北乡自刭。」
shots.en: Shot 6 (37–45 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: The Qin army lifts the siege; Hou Ying faces north and kills himself on the day the prince reaches Jin Bi's camp. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「秦军解围而去。侯嬴在公子到达晋鄙军中那天，北乡自刭。」

shots.zh: 镜头 7（45–51 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文；右下角朱印「窃符救赵」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处
shots.en: Shot 7 (45–51 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation; vermilion seal 「窃符救赵」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source

sound.zh: 背景乐：古琴，清远沉静，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：旷野风声、宫殿回响、夜风、战后余风；音效：竹简翻动、脚步声、衣袂摩挲、锤击；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。
sound.en: Music: guqin zither, serene and distant, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: wind over open plains, palace hall reverb, night wind, lingering wind after battle; SFX: bamboo slips rustling, footsteps, rustling silk, hammer strike; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

onScreenText.zh: 片头：右上竖排书法片名「窃符救赵」，副题「信陵君」，朱印「窃符救赵」；旁白字幕：简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体，白底留边；所有文字必须准确，不得出现错字、乱码或英文。

narration: 秦围邯郸。赵平原君之夫人，是魏公子信陵君之姊，数次遣使求救。
魏王派将军晋鄙率十万人救赵，却因秦王威胁，令其留军于邺，名为救赵，实持两端。
夷门监者侯嬴献计：兵符在王卧内，如姬最幸，能窃之。
如姬感公子为其报父仇之恩，果然窃得虎符。
晋鄙合符之后仍有疑心——
秦军解围而去。侯嬴在公子到达晋鄙军中那天，北乡自刭。

prompt.zh:
【水墨视频生成提示词】战国 · 窃符救赵（信陵君）

画幅与时长：16:9 横屏（1920×1080，竖屏可改 9:16 并保持主体居中），24fps，总长约 51 秒，共 7 个镜头；单镜时长超出生成器上限时可逐镜生成后剪辑。

风格：中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：咖啡色、酒红，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。

时代与场景：战国 · 魏安釐王二十年（前 257 年）。列国都城、长城雏形、步骑大军、竹简。

人物：
- 信陵君（魏·魏无忌）：深衣，胡服短衣；宫廷华服，发髻首饰精致；窃符夺晋鄙军，救赵
- 侯嬴（魏·夷门监者）：深衣，胡服短衣，漆皮甲，青铜长剑与弩；依身份的平民、工匠、侍从或兵卒衣着；献窃符之计，北乡自刭
- 如姬（魏·魏王宠姬）：深衣，胡服短衣；宫廷华服，发髻首饰精致；为信陵君窃得兵符
- 平原君（赵·赵胜）：深衣，胡服短衣；宫廷华服，发髻首饰精致；信陵君之姊夫，求救于魏
- 朱亥（魏·屠者）：深衣，胡服短衣，漆皮甲，青铜长剑与弩；依身份的平民、工匠、侍从或兵卒衣着；袖四十斤铁椎椎杀晋鄙
- 晋鄙（魏·魏将）：深衣，胡服短衣，漆皮甲，青铜长剑与弩；武将甲胄披挂，佩剑或执兵器；奉命屯兵于邺，被椎杀
- 魏安釐王（魏·魏圉）：深衣，胡服短衣，漆皮甲，青铜长剑与弩；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；畏秦，令晋鄙留军壁邺

分镜：
镜头 1（0–8 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：城墙雉堞、烟｜动作：邯郸被围，城头烽烟｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；焦墨勾出城垛轮廓；淡墨烟气横向飘散｜声音：环境：旷野风声｜屏幕文字：片名「窃符救赵」竖排书法与朱印「窃符救赵」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「秦围邯郸。赵平原君之夫人，是魏公子信陵君之姊，数次遣使求救。」
镜头 2（8–18 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：卷轴；主体：平原君｜动作：平原君书信不断，责魏不救｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：竹简翻动｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「魏王派将军晋鄙率十万人救赵，却因秦王威胁，令其留军于邺，名为救赵，实持两端。」
镜头 3（18–25 秒，7 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：城墙雉堞；主体：侯嬴、信陵君｜动作：夷门：侯嬴献计｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；焦墨勾出城垛轮廓｜声音：环境：夜风；音效：脚步声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「夷门监者侯嬴献计：兵符在王卧内，如姬最幸，能窃之。」
镜头 4（25–31 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：远景：月；中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：如姬｜动作：如姬入卧内，窃得兵符｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；重墨立柱，空间纵深；月轮留白，四周淡墨烘染｜声音：环境：夜风；音效：衣袂摩挲｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「如姬感公子为其报父仇之恩，果然窃得虎符。」
镜头 5（31–37 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：主体：大刀；飞白题字「铁椎」｜动作：邺下：铁椎一击｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；四角暗角收拢；兵刃金属寒光一闪；画面定格成一幅水墨画；泼墨飞溅，朱砂一点｜声音：环境：战后余风；音效：锤击｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「晋鄙合符之后仍有疑心——」
镜头 6（37–45 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；山河远景｜动作：正史结局：秦军解围而去。侯嬴在公子到达晋鄙军中那天，北乡自刭。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「秦军解围而去。侯嬴在公子到达晋鄙军中那天，北乡自刭。」
镜头 7（45–51 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文；右下角朱印「窃符救赵」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处

声音：背景乐：古琴，清远沉静，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：旷野风声、宫殿回响、夜风、战后余风；音效：竹简翻动、脚步声、衣袂摩挲、锤击；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

字幕与屏幕文字：片头：右上竖排书法片名「窃符救赵」，副题「信陵君」，朱印「窃符救赵」；旁白字幕：简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体，白底留边；所有文字必须准确，不得出现错字、乱码或英文。

负面提示词：写实照片，3D 渲染，CG 质感，油画厚涂，赛博朋克，日式动漫脸，美颜网红脸，高饱和霓虹色，现代建筑，现代服饰，汽车电线，塑料质感，英文字母，乱码文字，错别字，水印，签名，logo，多余肢体，手指畸形，五官崩坏，人物变形闪烁，画面抖动撕裂，时代错置：清代辫发与马褂、幞头与圆领袍、铁甲与马镫
prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Warring States period (475–221 BCE) · Stealing the Tally to Save Zhao: Lord Xinling (「窃符救赵」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 51 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained brown and wine red accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

Setting: Warring States period (475–221 BCE), 257 BCE — capital cities of rival states, early walls, massed infantry and cavalry, bamboo slips.

Characters:
- Xin Lingjun (信陵君) — royal / consort, Wei; shenyi robes, short "barbarian" riding tunics; rich court dress, elaborate hair ornaments
- Hou Ying (侯嬴) — commoner, Wei; shenyi robes, short "barbarian" riding tunics, lacquered leather armour, long bronze swords and crossbows; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate
- Ru Ji (如姬) — royal / consort, Wei; shenyi robes, short "barbarian" riding tunics; rich court dress, elaborate hair ornaments
- Ping Yuanjun (平原君) — royal / consort, Zhao; shenyi robes, short "barbarian" riding tunics; rich court dress, elaborate hair ornaments
- Zhu Hai (朱亥) — commoner, Wei; shenyi robes, short "barbarian" riding tunics, lacquered leather armour, long bronze swords and crossbows; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate
- Jin Bi (晋鄙) — general, Wei; shenyi robes, short "barbarian" riding tunics, lacquered leather armour, long bronze swords and crossbows; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand
- Wei Anliwang (魏安釐王) — ruler, Wei; shenyi robes, short "barbarian" riding tunics, lacquered leather armour, long bronze swords and crossbows; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–8 s, 8 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: crenellated city wall, smoke | Action: Handan under siege, beacon smoke on the walls | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; scorched-ink outline of battlements; pale ink smoke drifting sideways | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「窃符救赵」 with vermilion seal 「窃符救赵」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「秦围邯郸。赵平原君之夫人，是魏公子信陵君之姊，数次遣使求救。」
Shot 2 (8–18 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: scroll; subject: Ping Yuanjun | Action: Lord Pingyuan's letters keep coming, blaming Wei for not helping | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「魏王派将军晋鄙率十万人救赵，却因秦王威胁，令其留军于邺，名为救赵，实持两端。」
Shot 3 (18–25 s, 7 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: crenellated city wall; subject: Hou Ying, Xin Lingjun | Action: At the Yi Gate, Hou Ying offers a plan | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; scorched-ink outline of battlements | Sound: ambience: night wind; SFX: footsteps | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「夷门监者侯嬴献计：兵符在王卧内，如姬最幸，能窃之。」
Shot 4 (25–31 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: background: moon; midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Ru Ji | Action: Lady Ru steals the military tally from the king's chamber | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; heavy ink pillars giving depth; moon left blank with pale wash around it | Sound: ambience: night wind; SFX: rustling silk | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「如姬感公子为其报父仇之恩，果然窃得虎符。」
Shot 5 (31–37 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: subject: broadsword; dry-brush calligraphy 「铁椎」 | Action: At Ye an iron mace strikes | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; vignette closing in from the corners; a cold metallic glint on the blade; freeze into a still ink painting; ink splash with a single vermilion accent | Sound: ambience: lingering wind after battle; SFX: hammer strike | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「晋鄙合符之后仍有疑心——」
Shot 6 (37–45 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: The Qin army lifts the siege; Hou Ying faces north and kills himself on the day the prince reaches Jin Bi's camp. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「秦军解围而去。侯嬴在公子到达晋鄙军中那天，北乡自刭。」
Shot 7 (45–51 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation; vermilion seal 「窃符救赵」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source

Sound: Music: guqin zither, serene and distant, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: wind over open plains, palace hall reverb, night wind, lingering wind after battle; SFX: bamboo slips rustling, footsteps, rustling silk, hammer strike; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「窃符救赵」, subtitle 「信陵君」, vermilion seal 「窃符救赵」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets, futou caps and round-collar robes, iron plate armour and stirrups

strings.scene.zhanguo.jingke.title: 易水寒
strings.scene.zhanguo.jingke.subtitle: 荆轲刺秦王
strings.vo.01: 秦王政二十年。秦军已破赵，兵锋直指燕境。
strings.vo.02: 燕太子丹曾为质于秦，归国之后，日夜所思，唯有报秦。
strings.vo.03: 处士田光荐卫人荆轲。为求一见秦王，荆轲携秦亡将樊於期之首，与燕国督亢之图。
strings.scene.zhanguo.jingke.quote.yishui: 风萧萧兮易水寒，壮士一去兮不复还。
strings.vo.04: 咸阳宫上，副使秦舞阳面色骤变。荆轲回顾一笑，独自捧图上前。
strings.vo.05: 图卷徐徐展开，展到尽头——
strings.scene.zhanguo.jingke.fork.prompt: 此刻落笔，循哪一卷而书？

strings.scene.zhanguo.jingke.legend.disclaimer: 以下为野史所载，出自《燕丹子》一系的传说，《史记》不载。
strings.scene.zhanguo.jingke.end.canon: 荆轲倚柱而笑，事终不成。次年，秦军破蓟。
strings.scene.zhanguo.jingke.end.legend: 一曲未终，秦王已越屏而去。荆轲之结局，与正史同。

strings._note: 以上文字为本项目原创（史记原句“风萧萧兮易水寒……”为公有领域古籍引文，已在 caption 的 source 字段标明出处）。

cast.name: 荆轲
cast.title: 燕太子丹门客·刺客
cast.bio: 经田光推荐入太子丹门下，携樊於期首级与督亢地图入秦，于秦庭行刺未成被杀（书中第一百六、一百七回）。

cast.name: 太子丹
cast.title: 燕太子
cast.bio: 曾质于秦，归燕后谋刺秦王；先问计于鞠武，经田光得荆轲。

cast.name: 田光
cast.title: 燕处士
cast.bio: 向太子丹推荐荆轲，书中写其刎颈以激荆轲（第一百六回回目）。

cast.name: 鞠武
cast.title: 太子丹之傅
cast.bio: 太子丹先问计之人，引荐田光。

cast.name: 樊於期
cast.title: 秦亡将
cast.bio: 原秦将，传檄讨秦后奔燕（第一百三回回目）；其首级成为荆轲入秦之信物。

cast.name: 秦舞阳
cast.title: 荆轲副手
cast.bio: 随荆轲入秦的副手。

cast.name: 高渐离
cast.title: 击筑者
cast.bio: 荆轲之友，易水送别时击筑。

cast.name: 秦王政
cast.title: 秦王
cast.bio: 荆轲行刺的对象；书中秦庭一节写及屏风、鹿卢剑、铜柱等细节。

cast.name: 夏无且
cast.title: 秦侍医
cast.bio: 秦庭行刺时出手相救秦王的侍医。

cast.name: 蒙嘉
cast.title: 秦中庶子
cast.bio: 为燕使通报引见之人。

cast.name: 王翦
cast.title: 秦将
cast.bio: 行刺事后领兵伐燕（第一百七回回目“论兵法王翦代李信”）。

cast.name: 燕王喜
cast.title: 燕王
cast.bio: 太子丹之父。

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：咖啡色、酒红，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained brown and wine red accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

setting.zh: 战国 · 秦王政二十年（前 227 年）。列国都城、长城雏形、步骑大军、竹简。
setting.en: Warring States period (475–221 BCE), 227 BCE — capital cities of rival states, early walls, massed infantry and cavalry, bamboo slips.

characters.name: 荆轲

characters.en: Jing Ke (荆轲) — commoner, Yan; shenyi robes, short "barbarian" riding tunics, lacquered leather armour, long bronze swords and crossbows; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate

shots.vo: 秦王政二十年。秦军已破赵，兵锋直指燕境。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–6 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：大面积留白，只有淡墨远山｜动作：纸面淡入，远山一笔一笔画出，竖排题字｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入｜声音：环境：旷野风声｜屏幕文字：片名「易水寒」竖排书法与朱印「秦王政二十年」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「秦王政二十年。秦军已破赵，兵锋直指燕境。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–6 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: mostly empty paper with faint distant hills | Action: The paper fades in, hills drawn stroke by stroke, vertical title | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「易水寒」 with vermilion seal 「秦王政二十年」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「秦王政二十年。秦军已破赵，兵锋直指燕境。」

shots.vo: 燕太子丹曾为质于秦，归国之后，日夜所思，唯有报秦。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（6–13 秒，7 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：匣、地图卷；主体：太子丹、荆轲｜动作：燕宫：太子丹与荆轲；樊於期首级匣、督亢图｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入｜声音：仅背景乐｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「燕太子丹曾为质于秦，归国之后，日夜所思，唯有报秦。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (6–13 s, 7 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: wooden box, map scroll; subject: Tai Zidan, Jing Ke | Action: Yan palace: Crown Prince Dan and Jing Ke, Fan Wuqi's head in a box and the map of Dukang | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll | Sound: music only | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「燕太子丹曾为质于秦，归国之后，日夜所思，唯有报秦。」

shots.vo: 处士田光荐卫人荆轲。为求一见秦王，荆轲携秦亡将樊於期之首，与燕国督亢之图。

narration: 秦王政二十年。秦军已破赵，兵锋直指燕境。
燕太子丹曾为质于秦，归国之后，日夜所思，唯有报秦。
处士田光荐卫人荆轲。为求一见秦王，荆轲携秦亡将樊於期之首，与燕国督亢之图。
咸阳宫上，副使秦舞阳面色骤变。荆轲回顾一笑，独自捧图上前。
图卷徐徐展开，展到尽头——
荆轲倚柱而笑，事终不成。次年，秦军破蓟。
风萧萧兮易水寒，壮士一去兮不复还。

- 太子丹（燕·燕太子）：深衣，胡服短衣；宫廷华服，发髻首饰精致；曾质于秦，归燕后谋刺秦王；先问计于鞠武，经田光得荆轲。

- 王翦（秦·秦将）：深衣，胡服短衣，漆皮甲，青铜长剑与弩；武将甲胄披挂，佩剑或执兵器；行刺事后领兵伐燕（第一百七回回目“论兵法王翦代李信”）。
- 燕王喜（燕·燕王）：深衣，胡服短衣，漆皮甲，青铜长剑与弩；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；太子丹之父。

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Warring States period (475–221 BCE) · Cold Waters of the Yi: Jing Ke Attempts to Kill the King of Qin (「易水寒」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 49 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained brown and wine red accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.
